title: Anxiety

fields.treatment: Move more than 200m away from the Darkwalker

intro: Anxiety is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of two unique Afflictions found only within the Escape the Darkwalker Challenge.

title: Armoured

fields.name: Armoured
fields.desc: You're armoured up. Wearing the Ballistic Vest gives you outstanding physical Protection.
fields.duration: Until [Ballistic Vest] is removed or ruined.

intro: Armoured is a positive Affliction obtained when wearing a Ballistic Vest in the Accessories slot. The Affliction remains in effect as long as the Ballistic Vest remains equipped.

title: Blood Loss

fields.description: You are bleeding from a wound. If left untreated, you will continue to weaken until you die.

intro: Blood Loss is caused by a Wolf, Timberwolf, Poisoned Wolf, Cougar, or a Bear Struggle, a Timberwolf "bite-and-run" attack, or by falling off of a Mountaineering Rope.

title: Broken Body

fields.description: Your body carries the weight of a dying world.; ; You have lost the ability to recover Condition and are twice as vulnerable to physical damage.

intro: Broken Body is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Broken Ribs

fields.description: One or more of your ribs are broken. You cannot climb, and your mobility will be reduced until this injury heals.

intro: and 4 x |recoverytime=120 Hours|update=1.16|release=7 December 2017|description=One or more of your ribs are broken. You cannot climb, and your mobility will be reduced until this injury heals.|treatment2=2 x and 2 x }}Broken Ribs is an Affliction only acquired from a Moose Struggle.

title: Burdened
intro: Burdened is a unique Affliction in The Long Dark only encountered in Survival Mode when consuming certain Cooking Recipes. It was added in the Part 3 update to the Tales from the Far Territory.

title: Burns

fields.affliction duration: Until Treated or Recovery Time passes

intro: and 2 x |caused by=Fires

title: Cabin Fever

fields.description: You've been indoors so long you feel like the walls are closing in. You will be unable to sleep indoors for 24 hours.

intro: Cabin Fever is an Affliction in The Long Dark. This Affliction only appears when playing on the Voyageur, Stalker, Interloper, Misery, or enabled on Custom experiences in Survival Mode, or Hardened Survivor in Wintermute.

title: Cabin Fever Risk

fields.description: You've been indoors so long you are starting to feel very uneasy. Spend some time outdoors before it gets worse.

intro: Starting a Survival Mode game with the Settled Mind Feat selected will automatically prevent Cabin Fever Risk, and Cabin Fever, from ever developing.

title: Cheated Death Penalty

fields.affliction duration: Until Recovery Time passes or Permanent Affliction
fields.description: You have Cheated Death. Your maximum Condition is reduced each time you respawn.

intro: Cheated Death Penalty is an Affliction acquired after choosing to Cheat Death in Survival Mode.

fields.name: Chemical Poisoning
fields.desc: You are poisoned from an environmental hazard. The toxins have temporarily reduced your Condition.
fields.cause: Spending time inside a Chemical Hazard

title: Chemical Poisoning Risk

fields.name: Chemical Poisoning Risk
fields.description: You risk Poisoning by spending time inside a Chemical Hazard.
fields.treatment2: Equip {Iconlink|Respirator} w/ {Iconlink|Canister} and {Iconlink|Chemical Boots} to reduce vulnerability.

intro: w/ and to reduce vulnerability.}}

title: Concussion
intro: Concussion is a unique Affliction in The Long Dark only encountered in Wintermute during the mission Fallen Star in Episode 3: Crossroads Elegy. It shares the same icon as the Headache Affliction.

title: Dehydrated
intro: Dehydrated can affect the Crash Survivors Gwen, Ada, Logan, and Wade.

title: Dehydration Risk
intro: Dehydration Risk can affect the Crash Survivors Eric, Gwen, Ada, Logan, and Wade.

title: Diminished Form

fields.description: A morbid decay has set in.; ; You have less Stamina, and your carrying capacity is reduced. Sensing your vulnerability, Wolves are less likely to Flee during a Struggle.

intro: Diminished Form is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Dysentery

fields.description: You drank non-potable water and are now suffering an intestinal disease. You will weaken and die of dehydration unless you can treat it.

intro: Dysentery is a lethal disease that can be contracted by drinking Water (Unsafe). Drinking Unsafe Water does not immediately guarantee Dysentary due to RNG calculation chance, but generally speaking; the more Unsafe Water you drink, the greater your chance of contracting the disease.

title: Energy Boost

fields.benefit duration: {Iconlink|Emergency Stim} 60 minutes (75 minutes with Feat) {Iconlink|Go! Energy Drink} 30 minutes (37.5 minutes with Feat)

intro: 60 minutes (75 minutes with Feat)

title: Fatigue Reduced
intro: Fatigue Reduced is a positive Affliction gained by consuming certain Food And Drink or First Aid items.

title: Fear

fields.caused by: Being within 50m or less from the Darkwalker
fields.treatment: Move 50m (~164 feet) away from the Darkwalker

intro: Fear is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of two unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within the Escape the Darkwalker Challenge.

title: Food Poisoning

fields.caused by: Low Condition [Food And Drink] Eating Raw Meat
fields.description: Something you ate has made you very sick. You will weaken until you treat it, it passes, or you die.

intro: Food Poisoning is a negative affliction that is contracted by eating raw meat, or food with a low item Condition.

title: Frigid Bones

fields.description: You are chilled to the core.; ; Your Feels Like temperature is permanently reduced, and it takes you longer to warm up.

intro: Frigid Bones is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Frostbite

fields.description: You have sustained frostbite. Your general condition is permanently reduced.
fields.caused by: Exposed Bare Skin to the cold Wearing Frozen [Clothing]

intro: Frostbite is a physical Injury acquired from having bare skin exposed to the cold for too long and not managing Frostbite Risk, and permanently reduces overall Condition by 10%.

title: Frostbite Risk

fields.caused by: No [Clothing] on body parts ; Bare Skin exposed to inner layer Frozen Clothing
fields.description: Your skin is directly exposed to the cold. If it remains exposed for long enough, you'll get Frostbite.
fields.treatment: Warm and cover exposed body part

intro: Frostbite Risk is incurred when a player's bare skin is exposed to freezing conditions, particularly with severe windchill.

title: Gorged
intro: Gorged is acquired from consuming certain recipes that affect a survivor by temporarily decreasing their maximum Stamina by 15% for 1 hour.

title: Haunted Mind

fields.description: You experience an endless inner turmoil.; ; Your maximum Sleep time is reduced, and you recover 50% less Condition from Resting.

intro: Haunted Mind is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Headache

fields.caused by: Consuming [Food And Drink] or [Go! Energy Drink]
fields.description: (from Go! Energy Drink) You are suffering from a head-ache. It's not debilitating, but the occasional shot of pain and blurred vision can be distracting.

intro: Headache is an Affliction that is inflicted on the survivor after consuming certain First Aid or Food And Drink items.

title: Heat Pack (Affliction)

fields.description: You feel a gentle, temporary warmth from the Heat Pack tucked into your clothing.
fields.name: Heat Pack

intro: in inventory|+/- effect=Positive|type (Benefit/Injury/Disease)=Benefit|benefit duration=Until wears off/is dropped|release=2 December 2024|update=2.33|key=|description=You feel a gentle, temporary warmth from the Heat Pack tucked into your clothing.|name=Heat Pack|affliction duration=6 Hours}}Heat Pack is a positive Affliction obtained when using a Heat Pack. The effect raises the survivor's Warmt

title: Hyperglycemic Risk
intro: Hyperglycemia Risk is a unique Affliction in The Long Dark only encountered in Wintermute during the mission Fallen Star in Episode 3: Crossroads Elegy.

title: Hypothermia

fields.description: Your body temperature was too low for too long. You will weaken until you stay above freezing for 24 hours.
fields.treatment: Replenish [Warmth] and maintain it until Recovery Time elapses

intro: Hypothermia is an Affliction in The Long Dark, caused by exposure to the cold.

title: Hypothermia Risk

fields.description: Your body temperature is very low. If it remains low, you'll get Hypothermia.

intro: Hypothermia Risk is an Affliction in The Long Dark, caused by exposure to the cold.

title: Improved Rest
intro: Improved Rest is a positive affliction gained by eating or drinking certain Food And Drink and will increase condition gained while sleeping by an extra 2% (1% for Interloper) an hour while the benefit is still active. This benefit is used whenever sleeping, whether this be all at once or across multiple sleep sessions.

title: Infection

fields.description: You have an infection that could kill you if left untreated.

intro: An Infection is a life threating Affliction acquired from a Wolf, Timberwolf, Poisoned Wolf, Cougar, or Bear Struggle.

title: Infection Risk

fields.description: You sustained a wound that could result in infection if left untreated.

intro: There is a base 50% chance of receiving an Infection after 8 hours, with a maximum of 90% chance at the 24 hour mark. The chance of receiving an Infection increases by 5% per hour.

title: Insomnia

fields.description: Your sleep is troubled and Rest is frequently interrupted.

intro: Insomnia is an Affliction added to the Part 1 Update of the Tales from the Far Territory addon, and is contracted from spending too much time in Glimmer Fog found within certain Regions within the Far Territory Frontier. At present, it can only be contracted in the Forsaken Airfield, Zone of Contamination, and Sundered Pass Regions.

title: Insomnia Risk

fields.description: You risk Insomnia by spending time inside the Glimmer Fog

intro: Insomnia Risk is an Affliction added to the Part 1 Update of the Tales from the Far Territory addon, and is contracted from spending too much time in Glimmer Fog found within certain Regions within the Far Territory Frontier. At present, it can only be contracted in the Forsaken Airfield, Zone of Contamination, and Sundered Pass Regions.

title: Intestinal Parasites

fields.description: You ate infected meat and now have Intestinal Parasites. Recovery requires multiple daily treatments! You will continue to weaken until treatment has run its full course. [maximum 1 dose/day.]

intro: every 24 hours|recoverytime=10 Days (Stalker)

title: Laceration
intro: A Laceration may be inflicted during a Struggle. Lacerations instantly damage condition but do not require any treatment to remove, and because of this it never appears directly on the afflictions menu.

title: Major Bruising
intro: Major Bruising is an Affliction that may be inflicted or caused during a Struggle or from falls.

title: Minor Bruising
intro: Minor Bruising is an Affliction that may be inflicted or caused during a Struggle or from falls.

title: Nourished
intro: Nourished is a unique Affliction in The Long Dark only encountered in Survival Mode when consuming certain Cooking Recipes. It was added in the Part 3 update to the Tales from the Far Territory.

title: Pain

fields.affliction duration: Until Treated or Recovery Time Passes
fields.description: You are suffering from the pain of an injury, causing blurred vision and discomfort. Treat it, or let it heal on its own over time.

intro: Pain is a negative affliction introduced in the Steadfast Ranger update. It can be caused by a Sprained Wrist, Sprained Ankle, Struggle, or a fall.

title: Plane Crash Injuries

fields.description: After the plane crash you are concussed, badly briused(sic) and feeling weak. Your hand was wounded during the crash. You will not be able to climb or hold weapons until it heals through rest.

intro: It was acquired immediately after waking up in the ravine after the plane crash, and would persist for 5 Days. It prevents Will Mackenzie from Sprinting, holding Stones, or from using the Rock Climb to leave the ravine on Day 4 (Causing him to fall and Sprain his Ankle). It finally heals on Day 5, and serves as a way to slow the player down in order to immerse them in the world as part of the tuto

title: Restore Condition
intro: Restore Condition is a positive Affliction acquired after drinking Birch Bark Tea. This Affliction remains in place for up to 2 hours per tea consumed.

title: Rheumatic Joints

fields.description: A painful inflammation has taken hold.; ; You cannot Sprint as quickly, nor Aim a weapon for long before having to lower it. Sprains are more likely.

intro: Rheumatic Joints is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Risk of Intestinal Parasites

fields.description: Game meat from carnivorous animals may be infected with parasites.
fields.treatment2: Reach Level 5 [Cooking] to safely eat cooked meat

intro: Risk of Intestinal Parasites is an Affliction caused by consuming raw or cooked carnivore meat: Wolves, Timberwolves, Cougars, and Bears.

title: Scurvy

fields.treatment: Consume foods high in Vitamin-C to cure Scurvy
fields.description: You consumed a diet low in Vitamin-C for too long and now have Scurvy. If left untreated you will continue to weaken and lose condition until you succumb and die.

intro: Scurvy is an Affliction in The Long Dark. It is caused by consuming a diet with low/no Vitamin-C, and is lethal if untreated.

title: Scurvy Risk

fields.treatment: Consume foods high in Vitamin-C to cure Scurvy Risk
fields.description: Your diet is too low in Vitamin-C.

intro: Scurvy Risk is an Affliction in The Long Dark. It is caused by consuming a diet with low/no Vitamin-C, and results in Scurvy if left untreated.

title: Severe Lacerations

fields.description: You have sustained multiple deep slashing cuts from the Cougar's claws. Your Condition and Stamina are compromised, and you are at greater risk of Infection and Blood Loss until you are healed.

intro: Severe Lacerations is a physical Injury acquired from a Cougar Struggle.

title: Sour Stomach

fields.description: Your questionable diet has caught up with you.; ; You cannot eat as much before you feel full. You also are more likely to experience Food Poisoning, no matter your Skill level.

intro: Sour Stomach is an Affliction found within The Long Dark. It is one of 6 unique Afflictions that can be encountered only within Misery Mode experience.

title: Sprain Risk

fields.description: You are Exhausted or Encumbered, and at a higher risk for a Sprain when traversing sloped ground.

intro: A Sprain Risk is caused by a survivor's Encumbrance being over carry weight, and can result in potential sprains.

fields.affliction duration: Until Treated or Recovery Time passes
fields.description: You have twisted your ankle and are now suffering a sprain. Your mobility will be reduced until you treat it, or it heals over time.

title: Sprained Wrist

fields.affliction duration: Until Treated or Recovery Time passes
fields.description: You have sprained your wrist. You will not be able to hold weapons until you treat it, or it heals over time.

intro: }}A Sprained Wrist can be caused by a fall, being exhausted or encumbered while walking on uneven or steep terrain, or from an animal attack.

title: Suffocation
intro: Suffocation is a very short but highly lethal Affliction that occurs when the player character is exposed to toxic airborne gases. It is a rare but incredibly dangerous Affliction to encounter in Survival Mode, being present only within the Last Prospect mine and the Langston Mine.

title: Suffocation Risk

fields.treatment: Find breathable air or equip a {Iconlink|Respirator} with {Iconlink|Canister}
fields.description: You are running out of air to breathe. Find a pocket of clear air or equip a Respirator before you die.

intro: with |description=You are running out of air to breathe. Find a pocket of clear air or equip a Respirator before you die.|category=Afflictions|affliction duration=Until Treated}}

title: Sure Footing

fields.benefit duration: Until ; {Iconlink|Crampons}; or; {Iconlink|Improvised Crampons} are taken off or ruined
fields.description: The Crampons' steel spikes give you better traction in icy terrain. They make rope climbing easier, Sprains less frequent, and Weak Ice more forgiving.

intro: Sure Footing is a positive Affliction obtained when wearing Crampons or Improvised Crampons in the accessories slot. The effect remains in effect as long as the accessory remains equipped. If the player's footwear (shoes and 2 socks slots) are removed (whether by the player or their footwear is ruined) then their Crampons will automatically be removed, removing the affliction.

title: Torn Clothing
intro: Torn Clothing is a minor Affliction that can be encountered in The Long Dark. Torn Clothing is the only Affliction that is indirectly linked to the player's overall wellbeing, affecting their Clothing rather than their body or mind.

title: Toxic Fog

fields.caused by: Being within a Region where Toxic Fog reaches 100% saturation
fields.treatment: Leave the Toxic Fog covered Region

intro: The Toxic Fog is a feature included in the Escape the Darkwalker mode of The Long Dark.

title: Unburdened

fields.description: Your pack feels lighter because of something you ate.

intro: Unburdened is a unique Benefit Affliction in The Long Dark only encountered in Survival Mode when consuming certain Cooking Recipes. It was added in the Part 3 update to the Tales from the Far Territory.

title: Warming Up
intro: Warming Up is a positive benefit Affliction in the The Long Dark. The buff is gained by eating Food And Drink that has been warmed up by a fire and currently has the "HOT" status. While Warming Up is active, the rate of depletion of the Warmth meter while Feels Like is below 0 is reduced by half.

title: Weakened State

fields.description: You are weakened. For a time, your Condition will recover more slowly and your Stamina will drain more quickly.

intro: Weakened State is an Affliction acquired after choosing to Cheat Death.

title: Well Fed

fields.caused by: Survive 72 hours with Calorie Store above 0
fields.benefit duration: Until Calorie Store becomes 0 Acquiring [Chemical Poisoning]

intro: Well Fed is a positive Affliction gained by avoiding starvation.
